title: On the efficient computation of proximal operators of affine-constrained nonconvex functions
summary: Proximal operators with affine constraints arise in numerous models in nonconvex projection, composite optimization, and structured regularization. However, their efficient computation remains challenging due to the simultaneous presence of affine constraints and nonsmooth, possibly nonconvex objectives. In this work, we develop a unified dual-representability framework for analyzing and computing affine-constrained proximal mappings.
